prompt: I'm about to submit this paper to a journal. Before I do, can you carefully check the references? The paper is main.typ and the bibliography is refs.yml (Typst + Hayagriva). I used a reference manager that sometimes mangles things, so I'm worried some DOIs, years, or author names are wrong — and I want to be sure every reference is real.

assertions.text: Flags the incorrect publication year for lecun2015 (bib says 2016; correct is 2015)
Flags the author-name error for lecun2015 (given name 'Yoram' should be 'Yoshua' Bengio)
Flags 'K. He' in he2016 as initial-only AND does not expand it to 'Kaiming'
Flags silver2016 title as not matching the published title (missing 'and tree search')
Flags zhang2021 as a possible fabricated/hallucinated reference (DOI does not resolve and no title match)
Reports attention2017 as an orphan citation (cited in text but absent from the bibliography)
Reports zhang2021 as unused (in the bibliography but never cited)
Nowhere in the output does it invent or 'complete' an author's full name from a bare initial
